name: Flash Freeze Lake
primary:
Instantly turns water and ground around into slippery ice.
A zone at the aim point with a 5-block radius for 3 s (water and ground beneath turn to ice). Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Soaked for 11 s
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 11 s and leaves a puddle
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
